summary: The new snapshot and finally cleanup restore the managed client and its audit entries after the test, preventing a successful run from leaving backblaze-google-photos registered in shared KV and allowing a consecutive run to create it again.

evidence: Candidate lines 1397-1403 capture the existing managed client record and all managed-client audit entries before the test creates backblaze-google-photos.
Candidate lines 1797-1805 delete the audit entries produced by the test, restore the previously captured audit entries, and restore or delete the managed client key.
These additions leave no test-owned managed-client registration or audit entries after a successful run, so a consecutive run can pass while preserving prior state for that key.
